tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on MDF
tables.text: Table 288, "Effect of low-power modes on MDF", in section 35.5 (MDF low-power modes) on page 1673. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section35.3: MDF implementation for details about Stop modes supported by the MDF.

rows: No effect. MDF interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.

The MDF registers content is kept.
If the MDF is clocked by an internal oscillator available in Stop mode, the MDF remains active. The 
interrupts cause the device to exit Stop mode.
The MDF is powered down and must be reinitialized after exiting Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section35.3: MDF implementation for details about Stop modes supported by the MDF.
